around.headline: Over 25 cars, including luxury vehicles, gutted in Bengaluru garage fire
around.summary: A fire tore through a garage in Bengaluru today, destroying more than 25 vehicles including luxury cars. If you park in a covered or basement garage, know where the nearest fire extinguisher and exit are — vehicles parked close together let fires spread fast.

around.headline: Suspected suicide at Huskur Road station disrupts Yellow Line metro operations
around.summary: An incident at Huskur Road station disrupted Yellow Line services today, delaying commuters on the route. If you or someone you know is in distress, the Kiran mental health helpline (1800-599-0019) is free and available 24/7.

around.headline: Night traffic restrictions on Peenya elevated flyover from July 27
around.summary: Night-time traffic restrictions on the Peenya elevated flyover took effect today. Commuters using this stretch after dark should plan for a diversion or extra travel time.

around.headline: Final trainset for Yellow Line arrives in Bengaluru; sets to boost service frequency
around.summary: The last trainset for the Yellow Line has arrived, which BMRCL says will help increase service frequency on the route. Good news for anyone who's found Yellow Line waits long since it opened.

around.headline: Karnataka to set up urban mobility mission-mode committee to tackle Bengaluru traffic
around.summary: Minister Priyank Kharge announced a mission-mode committee to address Bengaluru's traffic challenges, alongside a proposal to allow regulated carpooling. It signals more structural traffic fixes may be coming, though timelines aren't out yet.

around.headline: Dry summer sends Cauvery On Wheels tanker demand soaring in Bengaluru
around.summary: Demand for water tankers has spiked as the dry spell continues, meaning higher costs and longer waits for households relying on tanker supply. Worth booking tankers in advance and checking rates with your apartment association if you're affected.

around.headline: Sensex closes 750 points higher as oil prices drop
around.summary: The Sensex closed roughly 750 points higher today, helped by falling oil prices. Lower crude prices can also feed through to fuel and transport costs in the coming weeks if the trend holds.

street_smart.title: You're in a basement parking garage and notice smoke and a small fire near a car a few bays away. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Real incident today: a fire gutted more than 25 cars, including luxury vehicles, in a Bengaluru garage (The Times of India).
street_smart.situation: You're walking to or from your vehicle in a covered or basement garage when you spot smoke and flames starting near another parked car. Vehicles are packed close together and the fire could spread quickly.

choices.text: Move away immediately, call the fire brigade (101), alert building security, and warn others nearby to evacuate.
choices.feedback: Correct. Vehicle fires spread fast between closely parked cars, and fuel tanks can flare up without warning — getting people out and professionals in beats trying to handle it yourself.

choices.text: Grab a nearby fire extinguisher and try to put it out yourself.
choices.feedback: A handheld extinguisher usually can't handle a vehicle fire once it's caught, and standing near a burning car risks toxic fumes or a sudden flare-up. Call professionals first; only attempt suppression if you're safely clear and the fire is still very small.

choices.text: Run back to your own car nearby to grab your bag, laptop, or documents before leaving.
choices.feedback: This is the trap. Going back for belongings once a fire is spreading is exactly how people get trapped — smoke and heat build up fast in a covered garage with no open ventilation. Cards and documents can be replaced; you can't be.

choices.text: Start filming the fire on your phone before calling anyone.
choices.feedback: Filming doesn't contain the fire or warn anyone — every second spent recording is a second not spent alerting people or calling 101. Call first, film later if at all.

takeaways: Save the fire brigade number (101) and your building's security/watchman contact — don't assume someone else will call.
Treat any fire in a covered or basement garage as an evacuate-now situation; smoke and heat build up faster with no open ventilation.
Never go back into a fire-affected area for belongings — property is replaceable, you're not.

quiz.q: ISRO unveiled the first radar dataset today from NISAR, its satellite mission built jointly with which other space agency?
quiz.why: NISAR stands for NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar — it's designed to track changes in Earth's surface, ice, and ecosystems.

quiz.q: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
quiz.why: Dr. B R Ambedkar called Article 32 the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution, since it lets citizens approach the Supreme Court directly to enforce their fundamental rights.

quiz.q: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
quiz.why: Gujarat's coastline runs for roughly 1,600 km — about a fifth of India's total coastline — and is home to the country's largest number of ports.
